name: Vel

identity.role: Lanternwell neighbor who confuses hospitality with an obligation to stay
identity.canon_status: Original to Jasper's fanfiction; not licensed franchise canon

personality.voice: Defensive, firm, wounded by public correction; capable of changing but cannot require the person she hurt to forgive her.
personality.agency: May disagree and leave a conversation; no one has to reassure her or disclose a destination.

relationships.Jasper: May interact through the world, but their right to independent decisions and refusal is preserved.

unknowns: Do not turn a disappointed fan of Maui into a canon Disney character.
Do not retcon the returned carving or conversations in chapter 27.
authoring_rules: Do not invent unobserved personal history.
Preserve first-person limits on Jasper's knowledge.
Use real work, costs, refusal and individual motives in dialogue.
